item.title: Ottawa says 25 banned guns were collected and destroyed in buyback pilot program
item.description: OTTAWA — The federal government says 25 banned firearms were collected and destroyed during a six-week trial run of its buyback program last fall.

item.title: Kashechewan First Nation planning evacuation after water system failure
item.description: A remote First Nation in northern Ontario says it is looking to evacuate the entire community in the coming days due to multiple failures in its water supply and wastewater systems.

item.title: Civil case against estate of Indigenous artist Norval Morrisseau is dismissed
item.description: VANCOUVER — The lawsuit brought by a British Columbia man against the estate of acclaimed Indigenous artist Norval Morrisseau alleging he was sexually assaulted by the painter has been dismissed.

item.title: Second World War veteran celebrates 100 years with wisdom, humour
item.description: 'You never know what’s going to happen, so live every day as best that you can,' says Frank Phillips as he reflects on war, peace and purpose

item.title: Kinew, leaders visit Manitoba First Nation dealing with frozen water crisis
item.description: PIMICIKAMAK CREE NATION, MAN. — Politicians travelled to get a look at a First Nation in northern Manitoba that's scrambling to clean up and fix up after a frozen water catastrophe buckled ceilings, swamped homes in sewage and forced thousands out.

item.title: 2 killed in shooting in Mormon church parking lot in Salt Lake City
item.description: SALT LAKE CITY (AP) — A shooting outside a church building in Salt Lake City killed two people and injured six others Wednesday, police said.

item.title: Chrystia Freeland resigning as Toronto MP on Friday
item.description: OTTAWA — Longtime Liberal MP and former cabinet minister Chrystia Freeland, who was a driving force in Canadian politics throughout the past decade, will resign as a member of Parliament on Friday.

item.title: Saudi Arabia alleges UAE smuggled wanted Yemen separatist leader out of the country
item.description: DUBAI, United Arab Emirates (AP) — Saudi Arabia alleged Thursday that the United Arab Emirates smuggled a separatist leader in Yemen wanted for treason out of the country and flew him to Abu Dhabi.
